research_notes: The research program should stop escalating only on evidence, not because a target sounds long subjectively.
If 14m and subsequent classes pass cleanly, coarse ascent should continue until a credible failure region or a practical external stopping constraint appears.
If no boundary is found, report the highest tested clean class as a lower bound only.
This avoids inventing a maximum where none has been observed.
The operating cap can still be chosen below that lower bound for practical reasons if needed, but must be labeled as policy rather than platform maximum.
Current run follows this evidence-first rule.
